caseName: Federal Power Commission v. Florida Power & Light Co.
caseNameFull: Federal Power Commission v. Florida Power & Light Co.

opinions.text:
C. A. 5th Cir. Motions of Gaines-ville Utilities Department et al. and American Public Power Assn, for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. Certiorari granted.

Mr. Justice Blackmun took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions and petition.
